cities.name: Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)
cities.overview: The capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, renamed from Port Blair in 2024, and the arrival point for flights and ferries.
cities.history: Founded as Port Blair by the British, who set up a penal colony here in 1858. It was renamed Sri Vijaya Puram in 2024. The Japanese occupied the islands during the Second World War.

cities.name: Swaraj Dweep (Havelock)
cities.overview: The most popular island for beaches and diving, about two hours by ferry from Sri Vijaya Puram; renamed from Havelock Island in 2018.

cities.name: Shaheed Dweep
cities.overview: A small coral island south of Havelock, known for quiet beaches and a natural rock bridge.

cities.name: Baratang
cities.overview: An island on the road north, with limestone caves and a mud volcano.

cities.name: Diglipur
cities.overview: The main town of North Andaman, close to the islands' highest peak and to Ross and Smith Islands.

cities.name: Long Island
cities.overview: A quiet forested island in Middle Andaman with few visitors.

cities.name: Campbell Bay
cities.overview: The main settlement on Great Nicobar.

places.name: Cellular Jail
places.shortDescription: The colonial prison known as Kala Pani, where freedom fighters were held in solitary cells, now a national memorial.
places.description: The Cellular Jail was built with seven wings radiating from a central tower, each lined with tiny solitary cells so no prisoner could see another. Three wings survive, along with the gallows, a museum and photo gallery about the freedom fighters held here, among them V. D. Savarkar and Batukeshwar Dutt. The evening light-and-sound show in the courtyard tells the jail's story. Climb the central tower for views over the harbour and Ross Island.
places.history: The British built the jail between 1896 and 1906 to hold political prisoners exiled from the mainland, a punishment known as Kala Pani. It was declared a national memorial in 1979.

entryFee.note: Small entry fee; the light-and-sound show is ticketed separately.

timings.hours: About 9:00 AM – 12:30 PM and 1:30 PM – 4:45 PM; closed Mondays

location.address: Atlanta Point, Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman and Nicobar Islands 744104

places.name: Ross Island (Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Dweep)
places.shortDescription: The former British administrative headquarters of the Andamans, now atmospheric ruins wrapped in tree roots.
places.description: A short boat ride from Sri Vijaya Puram, this small island was once the seat of British rule in the Andamans, with a church, bakery, ballroom, hospital and the chief commissioner's residence. Today the buildings stand roofless, overgrown by the roots of giant trees, while spotted deer and peacocks wander the lawns. A small museum explains the island's history, and an evening light-and-sound show is held on some days. Boats leave from the Aberdeen jetty.
places.history: The British occupied the island from 1858; it was damaged by an earthquake in 1941 and occupied by Japan during the Second World War. Subhas Chandra Bose hoisted the Indian tricolour in the islands in December 1943, and the island was renamed after him in 2018.

entryFee.note: Small entry fee plus boat fare from Aberdeen jetty.

timings.hours: Daytime; boats run roughly 8:30 AM – 2:00 PM

location.address: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Dweep, near Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman and Nicobar Islands

places.name: Radhanagar Beach
places.shortDescription: A broad arc of white sand and clear turquoise water on Swaraj Dweep, regularly ranked among Asia's best beaches.
places.description: Radhanagar (Beach No. 7) curves for about 2 km along the west coast of Swaraj Dweep, backed by tall forest. The sand is fine and white, the water clear and gentle in season, and sunsets here are famous. Lifeguards patrol a marked swimming area; take care with currents outside it. A short walk north leads to the secluded Neil's Cove. The beach holds the Blue Flag certification for cleanliness and safety.
places.history: Time magazine named Radhanagar the best beach in Asia in 2004. The island was renamed from Havelock to Swaraj Dweep in 2018.
places.bestTimeNote: November to April; seas are rough during the monsoon.

location.address: Radhanagar Beach, Swaraj Dweep, South Andaman, Andaman and Nicobar Islands 744211

places.name: Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park
places.shortDescription: A marine national park near Wandoor, known for snorkelling among coral at Jolly Buoy and Red Skin.
places.description: Boats run from Wandoor to the islands of Jolly Buoy and Red Skin, in turn by season, to see coral and fish through glass-bottom boats.
places.bestTimeNote: The two main islands open on rotation, so check which is open before you go.

location.address: Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), Andaman and Nicobar Islands

places.name: Viper Island
places.shortDescription: A small island near Sri Vijaya Puram, with the ruins of a British gallows and a prison.
places.description: The site of an early penal colony and gallows, now on the harbour cruise. It predates the Cellular Jail.

location.address: Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), Andaman and Nicobar Islands

images.alt: Viper Island, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)

places.name: Corbyn's Cove
places.shortDescription: A palm-lined beach near Sri Vijaya Puram, with water sports and a Japanese bunker close by.
places.description: A small, curved beach about 7 km from town, with jet skis and banana boats. It's the closest swimming beach to the capital.

location.address: Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), Andaman and Nicobar Islands

images.alt: Corbyn's Cove, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)

places.name: Chidiya Tapu
places.shortDescription: A forested bird-rich point at the southern tip of South Andaman, known for its sunsets.
places.description: The name means Bird Island. A walk through forest leads to Munda Pahar Beach, and the sunset here is the best on the island.

location.address: Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), Andaman and Nicobar Islands

images.alt: Chidiya Tapu, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)

places.name: Rani Jhansi Marine National Park
places.shortDescription: A marine park in Ritchie's Archipelago, founded in 1996, with coral reefs and mangroves.
places.description: Coral, mangroves and clear water in the islands around Havelock. It's a protected area, so most trips require permission.

location.address: Swaraj Dweep (Havelock), Andaman and Nicobar Islands

sources.title: Rani Jhansi Marine National Park – Wikipedia

places.name: Elephant Beach
places.shortDescription: A popular snorkelling beach on the north side of Swaraj Dweep, reached by boat or forest walk.
places.description: Clear shallows and coral close to shore, with sea walking and banana boats. A boat is quick, and the jungle walk is a good alternative.

location.address: Swaraj Dweep (Havelock), Andaman and Nicobar Islands

places.name: Neil Island
places.shortDescription: A quiet coral island with white beaches and a natural rock bridge, now Shaheed Dweep.
places.description: An easy cycling island, with Bharatpur Beach for swimming, Laxmanpur for sunset and the natural bridge exposed at low tide.

location.address: Shaheed Dweep, Andaman and Nicobar Islands

places.name: Baratang Limestone Caves
places.shortDescription: Limestone caves on Baratang, reached by boat through mangrove creeks, plus a mud volcano.
places.description: A boat trip through mangrove tunnels and a short forest walk lead you to these caves. The island's mud volcano is close by.

places.name: Barren Island
places.shortDescription: India's only active volcano, an uninhabited island in the Andaman Sea, seen only from boats.
places.description: No landing is allowed, but liveaboard dive boats sometimes circle the island. It's among the world's dive destinations.

places.name: Saddle Peak National Park
places.shortDescription: A forest around the highest point in the Andaman Islands, near Diglipur.
places.description: A full-day trek through tropical forest brings you to the top of the 732 m peak, with a view over the sea.

places.name: Long Island
places.shortDescription: A forested, car-free island in Middle Andaman, with the quiet Lalaji Bay beach.
places.description: Boats bring you to a small settlement, followed by a forest walk or boat to Lalaji Bay. It's a real escape from Havelock's crowds.

location.address: Long Island, Andaman and Nicobar Islands

places.name: Campbell Bay National Park
places.shortDescription: A remote rainforest national park on Great Nicobar, part of the biosphere reserve.
places.description: Dense tropical forest on India's southern tip, home to giant robber crabs. It's largely closed to tourists.
places.bestTimeNote: The Nicobar Islands are closed to most tourists, and even Indian citizens need special permission.

location.address: Campbell Bay, Andaman and Nicobar Islands

places.name: Galathea National Park
places.shortDescription: A remote national park on Great Nicobar, known for nesting giant leatherback turtles.
places.description: Forest and beach near the Galathea River, one of the main nesting sites in the Indian Ocean for leatherback turtles.
places.bestTimeNote: The Nicobar Islands are closed to most tourists, and even Indian citizens need special permission.

location.address: Campbell Bay, Andaman and Nicobar Islands
